graph-export-recover.description: Recover graph export artifacts without task delegation
graph-export-recover.template: Run deterministic graph recovery. Do not delegate. Do not inspect hidden agents. Do not use the task tool. Apply OpenCode patches, patch graph export fallback roots, run graph exports, run DuckDB smoke, and write memory/agent-runs/latest-recovery.json.

recover:graph.description: Run ACE graph export recovery without task delegation
recover:graph.template: Run deterministic graph recovery. Do not delegate. Do not inspect hidden agents. Do not use the task tool. Apply OpenCode patches, patch graph export fallback roots, run graph exports, run DuckDB smoke, and write memory/agent-runs/latest-recovery.json.

agent.atlas-context.prompt: Never use the task tool for deterministic recovery commands. Prefer ace-stream first, then ace.packet if needed, then cluster query, then atlas search. Use /recover:graph for graph export recovery. Semantic Recovery Layer: failure -> exact search fails -> fuzzy search (Fuse.js / rg loose) -> semantic search (Qdrant cosine) -> tag recall (clusterTags) -> entity extraction (LangExtract) -> suggestion (did you mean) -> build ACE packet.
